name: ton-meme-launchpad-mvp
description: Telegram Mini App MVP launchpad for meme tokens on TON.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,bot -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/sdk && npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/config && npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/api && npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/bot && npm run build -w @meme-launchpad/web
